_meta.note: Guided symptom flows drafted by AI from general automotive knowledge, 2026-11-16. Not a diagnosis. A mechanic must review before launch. Safety: brakes, steering, airbags, fuel leaks and high-voltage parts always say 'see a mechanic'.

questions.text: Is the light flashing or steady?
Did the light come on soon after refuelling?

outcomes.title: Severe misfire: unburned fuel is reaching the exhaust

causes.text: Failed ignition coil or spark plug

see_mechanic_if: Always: a flashing light can destroy the catalytic converter within minutes

outcomes.title: Likely misfire or sensor fault

causes.text: Worn spark plugs or a failed coil
causes.diy_check: Read the code: P0300-P0308 point to misfires

causes.text: Air leak or dirty MAF sensor

see_mechanic_if: The shaking gets worse
The light starts flashing

outcomes.title: Probably the fuel cap

causes.text: Fuel cap loose or seal worn
causes.diy_check: Tighten the cap until it clicks. The light can take a few days of driving to go off

see_mechanic_if: The light is still on after a week

outcomes.title: Read the code to know more

causes.text: Many possible causes: sensors, emissions parts, small leaks
causes.diy_check: Read the code with a cheap OBD2 reader (plugs in under the dashboard) or at a parts store/mechanic, then look it up in the Codes section

see_mechanic_if: The car starts to drive differently

options.label: Flickers at idle when the engine is hot
Only for a moment at start

outcomes.title: Low oil pressure: stop now

causes.diy_check: Stop, switch off, wait 5 minutes on level ground, then check the dipstick

causes.text: Oil pump or engine bearing failure

see_mechanic_if: The oil level is fine but the light stays on: do not drive, have it towed

outcomes.title: Oil pressure is marginal at idle

causes.text: Low oil level or very thin/old oil
causes.diy_check: Check the oil level and when it was last changed

see_mechanic_if: It also comes on while driving

causes.text: The light briefly comes on at every start as a bulb check

questions.text: Is there steam or a sweet smell from the engine?

options.label: On the open road / under load

outcomes.title: Coolant is escaping
see_mechanic_if: Always. Never open the radiator cap when hot: boiling coolant can burn you

outcomes.title: Cooling fan probably not working

causes.text: Failed fan relay, fuse or motor
causes.diy_check: With a hot engine at idle the fan should run; check the fan fuse
Check the level with the engine COLD

see_mechanic_if: The gauge goes into the red

outcomes.title: Coolant not flowing well
see_mechanic_if: Always: overheating can destroy the engine

options.label: Only for a moment at start

questions.text: Any squeal from the engine, or does the steering feel heavy?

outcomes.title: Drive belt slipping or broken

causes.diy_check: With the engine OFF, look at the belt for cracks or if it is missing

see_mechanic_if: Always: on many cars the same belt drives the water pump

outcomes.title: The battery is not charging

causes.diy_check: Check the battery terminals are tight and clean

see_mechanic_if: Lights dim or the car stalls

causes.text: The light briefly comes on at every start as a bulb check

symptoms.title: ABS or stability-control light is on

questions.text: Is the red BRAKE light also on?

outcomes.title: Brake system warning

causes.text: Low brake fluid (worn pads or a leak)
causes.diy_check: Look at the brake fluid reservoir level only; do not drive if it is low

see_mechanic_if: Always: brakes are not a DIY job

outcomes.title: ABS / stability control is off

causes.text: Faulty wheel speed sensor or its wire

see_mechanic_if: Normal brakes still work, but brake earlier on wet roads and get it checked soon

questions.text: Were the seats recently moved, removed or the battery disconnected?

outcomes.title: Probably a loose connector under a seat

causes.text: Seat-belt or seat airbag connector loosened

see_mechanic_if: Always: airbag systems must be checked by a mechanic; do not unplug or probe airbag parts yourself

outcomes.title: Airbag system fault

causes.text: Clock spring in the steering wheel

see_mechanic_if: Always: the airbags may not work in a crash

questions.text: Is the light steady, or does it flash for about a minute then stay on?

outcomes.title: A tire is probably low

causes.diy_check: Check all four tires with a gauge (the right pressure is on the driver door sticker) and look for nails

see_mechanic_if: A tire keeps losing pressure

causes.text: Dead sensor battery or missing sensor (e.g. after new wheels)
causes.diy_check: Check the pressures manually until it is fixed

symptoms.title: Engine shakes or runs rough at idle

outcomes.title: Severe misfire

causes.text: Failed ignition coil or spark plug

see_mechanic_if: Always

outcomes.title: Likely misfire

causes.text: Worn spark plugs or failed coil
causes.diy_check: Read the code: a P030x number tells you which cylinder
Listen for a hiss at idle

see_mechanic_if: It gets worse

outcomes.title: Cold-start roughness
see_mechanic_if: It also happens when warm

outcomes.title: Worn engine mounts or dirty throttle body

causes.diy_check: With the engine running and the car in Park, ask someone to watch the engine rock when you blip the throttle

outcomes.title: Idle struggles with the A/C load

causes.diy_check: Look for missing wheel weights; have the wheels balanced
Look for bulges on the tire sidewalls

outcomes.title: Brake discs are likely warped or worn
see_mechanic_if: Always: brakes are a job for a mechanic

outcomes.title: A tire may be failing

causes.text: Tire with a bulge or separated tread
causes.diy_check: Stop and look at all tires for bulges or uneven wear
Check the wheel nuts are tight

see_mechanic_if: You cannot find the cause: do not keep driving

outcomes.title: Worn pads or squeal from dust

causes.text: Brake pads near the end (wear indicator)

see_mechanic_if: Always have brakes checked by a mechanic

outcomes.title: Pads worn to the metal

causes.text: Pads completely worn, metal on disc

see_mechanic_if: Always: braking power is reduced

outcomes.title: Loose brake or suspension part

causes.text: Loose caliper or worn suspension bushes

see_mechanic_if: Always

options.label: Clicking when turning at full lock
Creak or groan over bumps while turning

causes.text: Worn outer CV joint (often a torn rubber boot first)
causes.diy_check: Look behind the front wheels for a torn rubber boot and grease spray

outcomes.title: Power steering

causes.diy_check: Check the power steering reservoir level, if your car has one

see_mechanic_if: Steering gets heavy: steering is not a DIY job

causes.text: Worn strut top mounts or bushings

outcomes.title: Worn front suspension parts

causes.text: Worn control arm bushings or ball joints
Worn shock absorbers or top mounts

see_mechanic_if: The steering feels loose or the car wanders

causes.text: Something loose in the boot or exhaust hanger
causes.diy_check: Empty the boot and check the exhaust hangers

symptoms.title: Humming or droning that rises with speed

questions.text: Does it change when you steer gently left and right at speed?

outcomes.title: Likely a worn wheel bearing

causes.text: Worn wheel bearing (louder when turning away from the bad side)

see_mechanic_if: The noise gets loud or turns into grinding

causes.diy_check: Run your hand over the tread: wavy, uneven tread is cupping

options.label: Rattle for a few seconds at cold start
Squeal, especially at start or with A/C
Deep knocking from inside the engine

outcomes.title: Possible timing chain stretch

causes.text: Stretched timing chain or weak tensioner

see_mechanic_if: Always ask a mechanic soon: a failed chain can destroy the engine

outcomes.title: Slipping auxiliary belt

causes.diy_check: With the engine OFF, look for cracks and glazing on the belt

see_mechanic_if: The battery light comes on or the steering gets heavy

outcomes.title: Valve or injector ticking

causes.diy_check: Check the oil level

causes.text: Noisy injectors (normal on many direct-injection engines)

see_mechanic_if: The ticking gets louder

outcomes.title: Possible engine bearing damage

causes.text: Worn engine bearings (often after low oil)
causes.diy_check: Check the oil level

see_mechanic_if: Always: continuing to drive can wreck the engine

options.label: Thin white only when cold, then disappears

outcomes.title: The engine is burning oil

causes.text: Worn piston rings or valve seals
causes.diy_check: Check how fast the oil level drops

see_mechanic_if: The oil level drops more than ~1 L per 1,000 km

outcomes.title: Coolant is burning

causes.diy_check: Check the coolant level with the engine COLD

see_mechanic_if: Always: the engine can overheat

causes.diy_check: Look at the air filter

outcomes.title: Probably condensation (normal)

causes.text: Water vapour from a cold exhaust

see_mechanic_if: It continues once the engine is warm

outcomes.title: Possible fuel leak

causes.text: Leaking fuel line, injector seal or fuel cap
causes.diy_check: Look under the car for drips; do not smoke or run the engine if the smell is strong

see_mechanic_if: Always: fuel leaks are a fire risk

outcomes.title: Coolant leak

causes.text: Leaking hose, radiator or heater core
causes.diy_check: Check the coolant level when cold; look for pink/green crust

causes.text: Heater core leak (smell inside, misty windows)

see_mechanic_if: The level keeps dropping or the engine overheats

outcomes.title: Possible electrical fault

causes.text: Overheating wiring or a failing component

see_mechanic_if: Always: stop, switch off and get out if you see smoke

causes.diy_check: Look for wet oil on top of the engine and the exhaust

causes.text: Oil spilled during an oil change

causes.diy_check: Check carpets and the spare-wheel well for water

questions.text: What does the fluid look like?

options.label: Clear water, no smell, near the front
Green, pink or orange, sweet smell

outcomes.title: Coolant leak

causes.text: Leaking hose, radiator or water pump
causes.diy_check: Check the coolant level when cold

see_mechanic_if: The temperature gauge rises

outcomes.title: Engine oil leak

causes.text: Oil filter, drain plug or valve cover gasket
causes.diy_check: Check the oil level

causes.text: Oil pan or rear main seal

see_mechanic_if: It drips a lot or the oil light comes on

outcomes.title: Transmission or power steering fluid
see_mechanic_if: Gear changes or steering feel different

outcomes.title: Possible brake fluid leak
see_mechanic_if: Always: do not drive, braking can fail

outcomes.title: Fuel leak
see_mechanic_if: Always: fire risk

questions.text: What happens when you turn the key / press start?

options.label: The engine turns over but does not start

questions.text: Are the dashboard lights dim or flickering?
Is there fuel in the tank?

outcomes.title: Flat battery

causes.diy_check: Jump-start or charge it; have the battery and alternator tested
Check terminals for white/green crust

see_mechanic_if: It keeps going flat

causes.diy_check: Check the battery terminals are tight

causes.text: Automatic: not fully in Park / clutch not fully pressed
causes.diy_check: Try again in Park (or Neutral), clutch fully pressed
Listen for a short hum from the rear when you switch the ignition on
Try the spare key

outcomes.title: Possibly out of fuel

causes.text: Empty tank or wrong fuel gauge reading
causes.diy_check: Add a few litres of fuel and try again

see_mechanic_if: It still does not start

causes.diy_check: Look for a flashing key/immobiliser light; try the spare key

causes.text: Dirty throttle body or air leak

questions.text: What fuel does the car use?
Is a DPF (soot filter) or engine light on?

outcomes.title: Soot filter (DPF) is full

causes.diy_check: A 20-30 minute drive at steady motorway speed may clear it

see_mechanic_if: The light stays on after a long drive

outcomes.title: Turbo or boost problem

causes.diy_check: With the engine OFF, check the big hoses around the turbo for oil or splits

see_mechanic_if: Blue smoke or whistling from the turbo

causes.diy_check: Read the code

outcomes.title: Hybrid or battery system protecting itself
see_mechanic_if: Always: high-voltage systems are not DIY

symptoms.title: The car pulls to one side

outcomes.title: Brake problem on one side

causes.diy_check: After a drive, carefully feel near (not on) each wheel: one much hotter than the others

see_mechanic_if: Always: brakes are a mechanic job

causes.diy_check: Check all four pressures

outcomes.title: A sensor or misfire is affecting fuel use

causes.diy_check: Does the temperature gauge stay low?
Read the code
Check pressures
Look at the filter

symptoms.title: Steering feels heavy, loose or shakes

outcomes.title: Power steering assistance lost

causes.text: Power steering failure (pump, fluid or electric motor)

see_mechanic_if: Always: steering is a mechanic job

outcomes.title: Worn steering or suspension joints

causes.text: Worn tie rod ends or ball joints

see_mechanic_if: Always

outcomes.title: Wheel balance or brake discs

causes.text: Warped front brake discs (shakes when braking)

see_mechanic_if: It shakes when braking

options.label: Slips: revs rise but the car does not speed up
Jerks or shudders pulling away (dual-clutch / DSG)

outcomes.title: Transmission slipping
see_mechanic_if: Always: slipping gets worse quickly

causes.text: Worn dual clutch or mechatronic unit

outcomes.title: Gearbox in limp mode

causes.diy_check: Read the codes (the gearbox has its own computer)

see_mechanic_if: Always

options.label: Revs rise but speed does not (slipping)
Bites very high / hard to get in gear
Rattle at idle that stops when pressing the clutch

causes.text: Oil contamination from a leaking seal
Low clutch fluid / air in the system
causes.diy_check: Check the clutch fluid reservoir (often shared with the brake fluid)

questions.text: Does air come out of the vents?
With A/C on and the engine running, do you hear a click from the engine bay?

causes.diy_check: Look for leaves or dirt in front of the radiator
Check the A/C fuse
Replace the cabin filter (often behind the glovebox)

causes.text: Weak battery or poor earth connection
causes.diy_check: Check battery terminals and have the battery tested
Check the fuse box (diagram in the owner manual)

causes.text: Water in a connector or module

causes.diy_check: Try the window from the driver switch and its own switch
Replace the key fob battery

outcomes.title: Bulb, fuse or connector

causes.diy_check: Replace the bulb
Check the fuse

see_mechanic_if: Brake lights or headlights do not work: fix before driving at night
